description: Free Food and Beverages FREE food Discounted Food Apps Starbucks McDonald's Arby's Chick-fil-A Free Food and Discounted Food Apps Starbucks McDonald's Arby's Chick-fil-A   If you regularly eat at fast food chains, you could save some serious cash by joining their rewards programs. Starbucks' app, for example, allows you to earn points on purchases that go towards free drinks and bakery items. At Red Robin, you'll get a free burger on your birthday as part of the rewards program.  If you love popular food chains like Starbucks, Chick-fil-A, and Domino's Pizza, you're missing out if you haven't downloaded their apps and joined their rewards programs.  From free food and beverages on your birthday to points that can be used towards future purchases, these rewards programs will help you save some serious cash if you are a frequent customer.  Panera Bread The best way to earn rewards at Panera Bread is to join the MyPanera program. By signing up for a MyPanera card, you can track your purchases and earn rewards like free bakery-cafe items and discounts on items you frequently purchase.  If you download the Panera Bread app, you can order and pay for your food ahead of time. Plus, you get a free bakery item just by signing up.  Starbucks By downloading the Starbucks app, you can earn stars for every purchase. For every 125 stars, you'll get a free drink. Plus, you can get a free drink or food item on your birthday.  Keep an eye out for out for opportunities to earn bonus stars, like buying the same drink three times in a given period or visiting Starbucks several days in a row.   McDonald's By downloading the McDonald's app, you'll not only be able to order and pay for food online, but you'll also have access to a wide variety of coupons.  Ongoing offers include getting a free McCafe beverage after the purchase of five, although there are also daily and limited-time discounts that change frequently.  Dunkin' Donuts If you're a Dunkin' Donuts fan, joining the DD Perks program is a must. You'll earn points with every purchase — with every 200 points, you get a free drink. Every dollar spent equals five points, so you only have to spend $40 to get a reward. You can keep track of and redeem these points through a physical DD Card or on the Dunkin' Donuts app.  Plus, you'll also get a free drink when you sign up for the program and on your birthday.   Chili's Chili's teamed up with Plenti, the rewards program created by American Express, for their money-saving program, so spending money there not only earns you rewards at the restaurant, but also at places like Exxon, Macys, Mobil, Nationwide, and Rite Aid.  You can earn free appetizers, desserts, and other items at Chili's, plus, you'll get a free dessert on your birthday.  Chick-fil-A The Chick-fil-A app offers all kinds of discounts and freebies for frequent restaurant visitors. As an app user, you can order ahead, pay on your phone, and rack up points to earn free food items.   Dairy Queen Dairy Queen's Blizzard Fan Club gives you several opportunities every year to earn free blizzards.  By signing up for the club's emails, you'll receive a buy-one-get-one-free Blizzard coupon as well as a free treat on your birthday.  Domino's Pizza When you enroll in Domino's Pizza's rewards program, you'll earn 1o points with every order of $10 or more. For every 60 points, you'll get a free medium two-topping pizza.  Plus, every month the company randomly gives away shares of its stock to 25 rewards members.   Jamba Juice As a Jamba Insider, you'll earn one point for every dollar spent, and a $3 off coupon for every 35 points.  Just for joining the program, you'll get $3 off your purchase as well as a free smoothie or juice on your birthday.  Red Robin If you sign up for the Red Robin Royalty program, you'll get a free burger during your birthday month, every 10th item you order is free, and you'll get $20 toward your sixth visit in the first five weeks after you sign up.

Free Food and Beverages FREE food Discounted Food Apps Starbucks McDonald's Arby's Chick-fil-A Free Food and Discounted Food Apps Starbucks McDonald's Arby's Chick-fil-A If you regularly eat at fast food chains, you could save some serious cash by joining their rewards programs. Starbucks' app, for example, allows you to earn points on purchases that go towards free drinks and bakery items. At Red Robin, you'll get a free burger on your birthday as part of the rewards program. If you love popular food chains like Starbucks, Chick-fil-A, and Domino's Pizza, you're missing out if you haven't downloaded their apps and joined their rewards programs. From free food and beverages on your birthday to points that can be used towards future purchases, these rewards programs will help you save some serious cash if you are a frequent customer. Panera Bread The best way to earn rewards at Panera Bread is to join the MyPanera program. By signing up for a MyPanera card, you can track your purchases and earn rewards like free bakery-cafe items and discounts on items you frequently purchase. If you download the Panera Bread app, you can order and pay for your food ahead of time. Plus, you get a free bakery item just by signing up. Starbucks By downloading the Starbucks app, you can earn stars for every purchase. For every 125 stars, you'll get a free drink. Plus, you can get a free drink or food item on your birthday. Keep an eye out for out for opportunities to earn bonus stars, like buying the same drink three times in a given period or visiting Starbucks several days in a row.

McDonald's By downloading the McDonald's app, you'll not only be able to order and pay for food online, but you'll also have access to a wide variety of coupons. Ongoing offers include getting a free McCafe beverage after the purchase of five, although there are also daily and limited-time discounts that change frequently. Dunkin' Donuts If you're a Dunkin' Donuts fan, joining the DD Perks program is a must. You'll earn points with every purchase — with every 200 points, you get a free drink. Every dollar spent equals five points, so you only have to spend $40 to get a reward. You can keep track of and redeem these points through a physical DD Card or on the Dunkin' Donuts app. Plus, you'll also get a free drink when you sign up for the program and on your birthday. Chili's Chili's teamed up with Plenti, the rewards program created by American Express, for their money-saving program, so spending money there not only earns you rewards at the restaurant, but also at places like Exxon, Macys, Mobil, Nationwide, and Rite Aid. You can earn free appetizers, desserts, and other items at Chili's, plus, you'll get a free dessert on your birthday. Chick-fil-A The Chick-fil-A app offers all kinds of discounts and freebies for frequent restaurant visitors. As an app user, you can order ahead, pay on your phone, and rack up points to earn free food items. Dairy Queen Dairy Queen's Blizzard Fan Club gives you several opportunities every year to earn free blizzards. By signing up for the club's emails, you'll receive a buy-one-get-one-free Blizzard coupon as well as a free treat on your

birthday. Domino's Pizza When you enroll in Domino's Pizza's rewards program, you'll earn 1o points with every order of $10 or more. For every 60 points, you'll get a free medium two-topping pizza. Plus, every month the company randomly gives away shares of its stock to 25 rewards members. Jamba Juice As a Jamba Insider, you'll earn one point for every dollar spent, and a $3 off coupon for every 35 points. Just for joining the program, you'll get $3 off your purchase as well as a free smoothie or juice on your birthday. Red Robin If you sign up for the Red Robin Royalty program, you'll get a free burger during your birthday month, every 10th item you order is free, and you'll get $20 toward your sixth visit in the first five weeks after you sign up.
